{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Accruals and Intangibles", 
"mechanism": "The combination of accruals and intangibles captures both financial statement and real economic activity, leading to a more comprehensive picture of a firm's profitability.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Accruals"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Momentum and Reversal", 
"mechanism": "The combination of momentum and reversal strategies captures both continuation and mean-reversion effects in stock prices, leading to a more robust portfolio.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "MomOffSeason"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},
{"name": "Value and Profitability", 
"mechanism": "The combination of value and profitability factors captures both the cheapness and quality of a firm, leading to a more attractive investment opportunity.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Growth and Investment", 
"mechanism": "The combination of growth and investment factors captures both the potential and actualized growth of a firm, leading to a more comprehensive picture of its prospects.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": !0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Investment"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Risk and Return", 
"mechanism": "The combination of risk and return factors captures both the potential downsides and upsides of an investment, leading to a more balanced portfolio.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Beta"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EP"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Quality and Yield", 
"mechanism": "The combination of quality and yield factors captures both the financial health and income generation potential of a firm, leading to a more attractive investment opportunity.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "PS"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "NetPayoutYield"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BetaFP", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Momentum and Volatility", 
"mechanism": "The combination of momentum and volatility factors captures both the trend and risk characteristics of a stock, leading to a more robust portfolio.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "RealizedVol"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},
{"name": "Value and Momentum", 
"mechanism": "The combination of value and momentum factors captures both the cheapness and trend characteristics of a stock, leading to a more attractive investment opportunity.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom6m"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "EP", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30}
]}}
